posts.post:
the guy who spends an hour deciding on an outfit, only to realize he’s going to be the most overdressed person in the room.

we’ve all been there.

we removed the internal care tags on the latest batch. 

they were itchy, unnecessary, and felt like an afterthought.
the 2:00 PM coffee run is the only time you actually see what people wear when they aren't trying to impress the office.
